dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. How do I get to the museum?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈɡɛt tə ðə mjuˈziːəm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Cross the street and go two blocks.
dialogue.reading: ˈkrɔːs ðə ˈstriːt ənd ˈɡoʊ ˈtuː ˈblɑːks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Then turn left at the traffic light.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈðɛn ˈtɜːrn ˈlɛft ət ðə ˈtræfɪk ˌlaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Is it on this map?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ɪz ɪt ɑːn ðɪs ˈmæp?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. It's here, next to the park.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ˈhɪr, ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈpɑːrk.
